queries.query:
from(bucket: "efd")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lsst.sal.Watcher.logevent_alarm")
  |> filter(
    fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "name" or
      r._field == "reason" or
      r._field == "severity" or
      r._field == "acknowledged" or
      r._field == "acknowledgedBy" or
      r._field == "mutedBy"
  )
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      sev = int(v: r.severity)
      return {
        r with
        severityName:
          if sev == 1 then "NONE"
          else if sev == 2 then "WARNING"
          else if sev == 3 then "SERIOUS"
          else if sev == 4 then "CRITICAL"
          else "UNKNOWN"
      }
    }
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "name", "reason", "severity", "severityName", "acknowledged", "acknowledgedBy", "mutedBy"])
